image_links.alt: A jelly-like siphonophore swims in dark blue water. It has several pairs of swimming bells with orangish-red zooids hanging below.
A small portable underwater robot drifts in blue water, tethered by a thin yellow cable to a ship out of frame.
A photo collage shows 13 transparent gelatinous animals on a black background.
A pair of gigantic blue whales surfaces to breathe. The whales are releasing large spouts of misty white water. In the background is gray-blue ocean, with hazy blue sky on the horizon.

Two summer interns process water samples in the lab aboard a research ship. The intern on the left is wearing purple gloves while transferring water from a thin glass tube into a large plastic tube inside a clear plastic bag. In the background are shelves of scientific equipment.
A scientist poses for a portrait in front of a robotic submersible inside a hangar aboard a research ship.
An illustration shows the daily vertical migration of animals from the deep sea during the day to the ocean’s surface in the evening.
Four people sit for a panel discussion inside a large auditorium during an international geopolitical conference.
A translucent pink sea cucumber with webbed feeding tentacles swims in open water.
A scientist wearing a yellow hard hat poses for a photo while crouched down next to a scientific instrument on the outdoor deck of a research ship on an overcast day.
Three scientists pose for a photo on a raised stage in a large conference room. The scientist in the middle is holding a framed print of an illustration of a deep-sea organism.
